comment: Each kit's finish on the stage and slot cards (blender-kit.py kit=<id>). Colours are linear RGB. shell and snare: style lacquer | pearl | stain | sparkle | metal, color, and color2 (the pattern's other colour). hoops: chrome | black | brass, or a material like shell. kickHoop: the kick's wooden hoops, like shell (default: the shell's). lugs: chrome | black | brass. ropeNet: { color }: the kick and toms are rope-tensioned, with a net of cord over the shell and no lugs. heads, reso: colours of the batter heads and the kick's front head. Kits not listed keep the default red; presets use their base kit's finish.

drskit-full.comment: DRS Drums in orange oyster, from the session photo; a white pearl snare.

muldjordkit.comment: Black Tama with chrome hardware, from the session photo; a steel snare.

salamander.comment: Green stained shells in a matte finish with dark wooden hoops, from the session photo; a natural wood snare (also matte), a white front head. The kick and toms are rope-tensioned: a net of white cord, no lugs.

naked-drums.comment: Natural maple, the kick and toms matte and the snare satin (Virtuosity's old colours, swapped once a photo of the Virtuosity kit turned up).

crocellkit-full.comment: Proposed: midnight blue sparkle with black hardware, a black nickel snare.

sm-drums.comment: A 1960s Ludwig in Oyster Blue Pearl (from the library's notes), a chrome snare, a white front head.

big-rusty.comment: Proposed: a hand-made vintage kit in rusty brown stain with wooden hoops, an aged brass snare.

virtuosity.comment: Deep cherry kick and toms in a matte finish, a silver snare, a white front head (from a photo of the Virtuosity kit).

basalt-onyx.comment: Proposed, after its name: black with a faint sparkle, black hardware.

basalt-garnet.comment: Proposed, after its name: deep garnet red sparkle.

basalt-amber.comment: Proposed, after its name: amber stain, brass hardware.

basalt-cobblestone.comment: Proposed, after its name: grey stone pearl.

tchimera.comment: Champagne sparkle like a vintage Ludwig (the user asked for champagne gold sparkle with a silver snare, from a photo of a Ludwig champagne kit); a chrome snare and a white front head, as in the photo.
